pages.title: Observatories
pages.text: Round towers of pale brick under a dark glass dome, on the open Hollow and in the Crystal Barrens. Someone watched the sky here.$(br2)A study below, star charts above, and at the top a copper telescope aimed through a slit in the dome, with the best of their finds beside it.

pages.title: The Sunken Library
pages.text: A long hall of prismarine on the floor of the Mirror Sea, its roof fallen in. The shelves are drowned but the chests at the far end are not empty: enchanted books, pages worth Knowledge, and runes for spell crafting.$(br2)Bring a way to breathe. A $(l)Tidebound Charm$() or $(l)Lurkerscale Leggings$() will do.

pages.title: Ruins
pages.text: The Hollow is scattered with what's left of older builders: a broken archway, a ring of fallen pillars around a cold altar, and stairs leading down into small buried vaults.$(br2)Most hold a chest of materials and supplies. The vaults are easy to walk past; look for low walls framing a gap in the ground.
